card.name: TH in LIFE-THREATENING warnings
card.fires_on: Mainly the split-off "TH" in capitalized "LIFE-THREATENING" in boxed warning headings. Also fires on a few unrelated word starts such as "aut" in "autoloader".

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The "TH" piece after LIFE- in all-caps or hyphenated "life-threatening" headings.
modes.example: BOXED WARNING WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-<<TH>>REATENING RISKS FROM USE

modes.label: Stray word starts
modes.description: Occasional word starts in general web text, such as the start of a mechanical term.
modes.example: replace the human loader with a mechanical<< aut>>oloader, cutting the crew to three

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words for equipment and installation, so there is no clear link to the medical text.
card.plain: It lights up on the "TH" in the all-caps LIFE-THREATENING warning headline.
